XPD.Architecture: A temporary city, built by hand by architects and makers deep in the forest. Twenty neighborhoods to get lost in, and many live on after the festival.
XPD.Music: Find your next favorite band in a forest cathedral, a barn, or a meadow at sunset.
XPD.DJs: Dance in the trees until the stars come out, and long after.
XPD.Family: Bring the kids. They get a summer camp of their own: nature play, workshops and music.
XPD.Comedy: Laugh until it hurts, shoulder to shoulder in a wooden barn.
XPD.Literary: Slow down for stories and poems, read aloud beneath the trees.
XPD.Wellness: Start the day with yoga, find quiet in the Refuge, and wander almost four miles of forest trails.
XPD.Food: Sit down at a long table in the woods, or eat your way through local kitchens all weekend.
XPD.Craft: Meet the makers and take home something made by hand.
XPD.Drinks: Raise a glass under the trees: local beer, wine and cocktails beside the stages.
XPD.Art: Wander into installations that glow in the woods after dark.
XPD.Camping: Four camps, each its own world: deep forest, giant ferns, or your own rig. Fall asleep in the woods and walk in to the music.

Music.woods: Twelve straight hours of music in a big-leaf maple cathedral the forest grew around.
Music.paddock: The biggest open-air moments of the weekend, in a meadow bowl as the sun goes down.
Music.cherryhill: The Woods’ dark, mysterious sister: student-built stages that come alive late at night.
Music.grove: Sets in the shade of a Douglas fir grove, on a stage that is part sculpture.
Music.windmill: Up on the hillside under towering firs and the farm’s old windmill, with Mount Hood in view.
Music.galaxy: Cool daytime sets and late-night ragers in one of the few air-conditioned rooms on the farm.
Music.lucky: The most intimate room on the farm, with shaded seats outside while you wait.
Music.farmhouse: A busking stage at the front door of the farm, where the weekend begins.

DJs.woods: When the bands stop, the forest cathedral becomes a dance floor.
DJs.cherryhill: Dance beneath the student-built towers as the night gets deep.
DJs.windmill: Afternoon sets on the hillside, under the firs.
DJs.courtyard: The open-air dance floor outside the barn, around two giant wooden water lilies.
DJs.market: Records spinning at the crossroads of the festival, where friends find each other.

Family.coyote: Captain Coyote’s world in the woods above Cherry Hill: music, art and nature all day.

Comedy.lucky: Laughs in the Lucky Barn: touring comics, two nights, ninety packed minutes.

Literary.woods: Sunday morning storytelling and spoken word on the Woods Stage.
Literary.windmill: Authors read from their work on the hillside, Sunday morning.

Wellness.lucky: Slow movement in the barn before the music starts.
Wellness.courtyard: Rise-and-shine yoga on the open-air plaza.
Wellness.refuge: Our wellness home in the forest: massage under the trees, plant meditation and a sober-friendly place to rest.
Wellness.coyote: Movement and play for the whole family in the woods above Cherry Hill.
Wellness.windmill: Morning runs and forest hikes start at the Windmill Stage.
Wellness.trails: Almost four miles of forest trails to wander, from the creek up toward Scouters Mountain.

Food.curation: A hundred seats at a hidden table by the creek, the meal made by a chef and an artist together.
Food.market: Northwest kitchens, food trucks and a farmers market of fresh fruit.
Food.windmill: Food vendors under the firs on the hillside.
Food.lucky: A bite between shows on the main path through the farm.

Craft.market: Craft Row and the Craft Tent: makers, artists and handmade goods.
Craft.paddock: Secondhand treasures and repurposed finds at the Merry Pop In Shop.

Drinks.woods: The bar glowing in the trees after dark.
Drinks.windmill: The Windmill Bar on the hillside, with zero-proof options too.
Drinks.curation: Wine and cocktails poured alongside every Curation meal.
Drinks.grove: A cold drink in the shade of the firs.
Drinks.courtyard: The Galaxy Bar, steps from the dance floor.
Drinks.market: The Market Bar at the heart of the festival.

Art.windmill: Watch murals painted live, then pick up a brush in the workshop.
Art.quailtrail: The Grotto Gallery, just up the trail from the Market.

Camping.wildcamp: Big trees and a hillside of tents: camp deep in the forest, a short walk from the stages.
Camping.lushcamp: Giant ferns and leafy shade: wake up under a green canopy.
Camping.willowcamp: Car, van and RV camping: sleep in your rig and walk in to the music.
Camping.southcamp: Car, van and RV camping in the South Lot, with the shuttle and ticketing close by.
